player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I assigned a high score to "Dismissive" (8) and "Confident" (7) while giving "Scared" a low score (2), which contradicted the narrative arc of the dialogue. The character Ace is being directly threatened with capture ("Will you survive when I catch up to you?") and is being called out on their confidence ("You seem pretty confident about that"). In this context, Ace's previous casual attitude is being dismantled, making fear the most likely and intense reaction, not dismissal or confidence. I should have prioritized "Scared" as the primary emotion (score 9 or 10) and significantly reduced the scores for "Confident" and "Dismissive" to reflect the character's realization of their vulnerability.
